HUBB should remain a reference anchor for scaled utility-qualified transmission hardware through Burndy/Fargo, but its large-cap status and broader electrical platform reduce underfollowed alpha fit.

AZZ is a second-order process/materials candidate: galvanizing and coatings are potential bottleneck-adjacent services for outdoor T&D steel structures and components, but materiality to the specific line-hardware node needs verification.

node: Transmission-line hardware, conductor fittings, clamps, spacers, dead-ends, vibration dampers, and line accessories
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one unusually direct underfollowed pure-play candidate, one high-quality but higher-attention reference supplier, and two second-order infrastructure/materials names tied to utility transmission buildout. The highest node-fit name is Preformed Line Products, because its disclosed product set directly includes string hardware, polymer insulators, substation fittings, spacer dampers, cable dynamics/vibration solutions, pole-line hardware, and related transmission/distribution accessories. Hubbell is a stronger scaled reference anchor through Burndy/Fargo transmission connectors, dead-ends, spacers, and dampers, but its market cap and broader electrical platform reduce underfollowed purity. Valmont and AZZ are not direct conductor-fitting pure plays; they are second-order grid-hardware beneficiaries through transmission structures, poles, substation components, and galvanizing/corrosion protection for T&D infrastructure. No buy/sell view is implied.
